text:
Maya Tran: quick check-in — prepping slides for Monday's weekly KPI review and noticed the launch post cohort for May A is underperforming vs the B variant after day 5. DAU->trial down ~18% :confused_face:
Evan Cole: interesting. is this the wording A/B (short headline) or the distribution mix?
Maya Tran: both maybe. A was the short-headline social push + partner X, B was longer copy + email nurture. initial CTRs were similar but downstream trial conversion diverged starting day 5
Jorge Rivas: could be attribution window or scoring changes. we rolled a lead_score update two weeks ago that bumps nurture leads to higher priority — may change MQL timing
Leah Park: FYI we also changed the webinar registration redirect last week (added a GA redirect) which strips utm_term for some paid tags; that could push a chunk into "direct" in GA -> dashboard mismatch
Tom B: pulseboard pulls raw event utms, but the weekly exec deck pulls CRM MQLs (which get post-processed by leadflow). so two different pipelines showing different stories
Maya Tran: ugh. so we might be seeing measurement noise not actual lift loss. can someone run a parity diff: raw events, crm-backed, and lead_score-adjusted series for the two variants?
Evan Cole: i'll pull the weekly sheet and add a tab for raw vs crm vs scored. will need the mapping of variant tags to partner keys.
Jorge Rivas: paste the queries you'd like. i'll run joins and produce a CSV with three columns per day per variant.
Maya Tran: base query i used: ```SELECT cohort_day, variant, count(distinct user_id) as trials FROM events WHERE event='trial_start' AND campaign='may_launch' GROUP BY cohort_day, variant ORDER BY cohort_day;```
Leah Park: also include a filter for "utm_term is null" to catch potential redirect-stripped registrants. i can export that list for session tracing
ops-bot: Note: lead-score-updates job completed 2026-03-18T04:12:00Z. affected_rows=14200.
Jorge Rivas: ran parity diff quickly: raw_events show A dips at day 5, crm_backfilled is flatter, scored-series shifts ~+3 days for nurture -> some conversions reclassify later. CSV will be uploaded in ~10m
Maya Tran: that suggests attribution + scoring timing explains much of the delta. still want to confirm with session traces for a sample of 150 users from variant A
Leah Park: will grab 150 sessions (focus on utm_term null and partner X). will check if trial_start events were delayed or missing
Tom B: can we add a small metadata flag on the weekly KPI sheet that lists recent pipeline changes (lead-score, routing, backfills) so PMs don't misinterpret week-over-week? low effort and would help
Evan Cole: yes — i'll add a "pipeline_changes" cell at the top of the sheet and include links to run ids. also will annotate the slide deck with raw vs crm truth table
Jorge Rivas: CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/files/may_ab_parity_316555.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
Maya Tran: nice work. action items: Jorge attach CSV to the deck, Leah session traces, Evan update deck + sheet metadata, Tom add pipeline flag on pulseboard
Leah Park: pulling sessions now. FYI found ~42 sessions where registration happened without utm_term but had a referrer from partner X — that matches the gap
Maya Tran: ok, for the exec slide let's present: 1) observed delta, 2) parity finding (attribution + scoring timing), 3) estimated impact (~14% of A's apparent loss reclassified), 4) next steps (add checks + pre-launch redirect checklist). keep it 2 bullets + one chart
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "KPI parity quicksync" 2026-03-19T09:00:00Z, duration 20m. invites: Maya Tran, Evan Cole, Jorge Rivas, Leah Park, Tom B
Evan Cole: i'll draft the 2-bullet exec note after Leah's session traces. timeline: today EOD
Tom B: metadata flag live on pulseboard (staging). will push to prod after QA
Maya Tran: thanks team. let's avoid jumping on product changes until we confirm measurement vs real conversion drop. meet at the quicksync. :thumbsup:
